title: ErosionKernel config
description:
Spec 19 ErosionKernel — hydraulic + thermal erosion over a pre-existing heightmap. Pre-bake global pass (not per-page) per spec 19 §'World-size bound'; output cached per spec 12 content addressing.

References:
- Hydraulic: Mei et al. 2007 'Fast Hydraulic Erosion Simulation and Visualization on GPU' (Pacific Graphics)
- Thermal: Musgrave/Kolb classic — angle-of-repose-driven slope diffusion

Inputs: height field (numpy array) + params.
Outputs: eroded height field + drainage_map + flow_direction + flow_accumulation per spec 19 §'Auxiliary outputs' (consumed by spec 35 water + spec 41 roads).

_schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump when the contract changes incompatibly.

_note.description: Human-readable annotation; ignored by the loader.

iterations.description: Number of simulation timesteps. Higher = more eroded. Typical: 50-200 for visible features; 500+ for heavy carving. Per spec 19 Quality bar, must complete a 1024² grid in ≤ 60s on dev hardware (Python reference; GPU is faster).

rain_rate.description: Water added per cell per iteration (m/iter). Sets the dominant flow magnitude. Higher = faster carving but also faster drying (paired with evaporation).

evaporation.description: Fraction of water that evaporates per iteration. 0 = water accumulates forever; 1 = water gone immediately. Mei 2007 default range: 0.005-0.05.

sediment_capacity.description: Max sediment a unit of flowing water can carry. Higher = more aggressive carving. Mei 2007 'Kc' constant.

dissolve_rate.description: Fraction of capacity-deficit dissolved into water per iteration (where capacity > current sediment). Higher = faster erosion in carving zones.

deposit_rate.description: Fraction of capacity-excess deposited from water per iteration (where current sediment > capacity). Higher = faster deposition in deposition zones.

min_slope.description: Minimum effective slope (radians) used in capacity = Kc * sin(slope) * flow_velocity. Prevents capacity from collapsing to 0 on flat ground (which would freeze the simulation). Mei 2007 'minSlope' floor.

gravity.description: Gravitational acceleration (m/s²). Affects flow velocity calculation in the hydraulic pass. Default Earth; can model Mars (3.71) or Moon (1.62) etc.

thermal_iterations.description: Number of thermal-erosion (talus) timesteps interleaved with hydraulic. 0 disables thermal pass entirely. Thermal slumps material on slopes steeper than talus_angle_deg.

talus_angle_deg.description: Angle-of-repose threshold (degrees). Slopes steeper than this slump per thermal iteration. Typical alpine: 30-40°; loose sand: 25-30°; bedrock: 60°+.

talus_rate.description: Fraction of excess slope material moved per thermal iteration. Higher = faster slumping.

seed.description: Random seed (currently unused; deterministic given height_in + params). Reserved for any future stochastic-rainfall variation.
